messages.text: Hey! Quick question, what time do you guys open tomorrow? I'm thinking of swinging by for a cappuccino.
We are open starting at 7:00 AM on Monday through Thursday, and 7:00 AM on Friday. We open at 8:00 AM on Saturday, and we are closed on Sunday.
Great, thanks for the hours! So if I'm coming in tomorrow, what time are you opening? I'm planning to get a cold brew.
Could you please specify what day you are coming in? We open at 7:00 AM on Monday through Thursday and Friday, and at 8:00 AM on Saturday.
I'll be in tomorrow, Wednesday! What time should I swing by for a cappuccino? I come in all the time.
We open at 7:00 AM tomorrow (Wednesday). We would be happy to prepare a cappuccino for you.
